import os,sys,json,shutil,subprocess,tarfile
from pathlib import Path
r=Path(sys.argv[1]);sys.path.insert(0,str(r/'source/solvers/IncNavierStokesSolver/Tests/RANS'))
from rans_request_manifest import RequestManifest,sha
from ct_accepted_feasibility import write_json
out=r/'observer-input-v2'
requests={}
for name in ('build-v4','input-control-v1'):
 p=r/name;req=json.loads((p/'request-manifest.json').read_text());seal=json.loads((p/'completed-artifacts.json').read_text())
 assert req['sha256']==seal['request_sha256']
 for f,h in seal['files'].items():assert sha(p/f)==h
 e=json.loads((r/('resources-'+name)/'execution.json').read_text())
 assert e['exit_code']==0 and e['resource']['aggregate_status']==e['resource']['project_status']=='pass'
 requests[name]={'request_sha256':sha(p/'request-manifest.json'),'seal_sha256':sha(p/'completed-artifacts.json'),'resource_sha256':sha(r/('resources-'+name)/'execution.json')}
data=json.loads((r/'input-control-v1/results.json').read_text());assert data['status']=='pass'
revision=subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','core.preloadIndex=false','-c','index.threads=1','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=r/'source',text=True).strip()
m=RequestManifest(out,{'schema':'CT10ObserverInputSupplementV2','source_revision':revision,'inputs':requests,'scope':'read-only observer input transparency; original initial attribution and governing histories unchanged; raw traction remains separate'})
for name in requests:
 dest=out/name;dest.mkdir()
 for f in ('results.json','request-manifest.json','completed-artifacts.json'):shutil.copy2(r/name/f,dest/f)
 dest=out/('resources-'+name);dest.mkdir()
 for p in (r/('resources-'+name)).iterdir():
  if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.json','.jsonl'):shutil.copy2(p,dest/p.name)
build=json.loads((r/'build-v4/results.json').read_text())
write_json(out/'provenance.json',{'source_revision':revision,'diagnostic':build['diagnostic'],'governing':build['governing'],'schema':'CT10SignedMomentumV2','checks':{k:{n:v[n] for n in ('status','time','state_sha256','maximum_original_residual_difference','governing_matching_enabled','maximum_input_lift_difference')} for k,v in data['checks'].items()},'original_qualified_v1_seal':sha(r/'qualified-v1/completed-artifacts.json'),'scope':'governing Residual effective-input policy is exposed; no governing source/state/history changes; raw accepted-state traction and epsilon lag remain direct coefficient diagnostics'})
files=[str(p.relative_to(out)) for p in out.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name not in ('request-manifest.json','completed-artifacts.json')]
# Also bind nested manifests and seals.
files+= [str(p.relative_to(out)) for p in out.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.parent!=out and p.name in ('request-manifest.json','completed-artifacts.json')]
m.seal(out,files)
with tarfile.open(r/'observer-input-v2.tar.gz','w:gz') as t:t.add(out,arcname=out.name)
print(json.dumps({'checks':json.loads((out/'provenance.json').read_text())['checks'],'diagnostic':build['diagnostic'],'archive_sha256':sha(r/'observer-input-v2.tar.gz')},indent=2))
